_about: Wave 5 additions to validation/validation-params.json (run-2026-10-04-fable51-01). Merge rule: list keys are UNIONED into the existing list (order kept, duplicates dropped); map and scalar keys are ADDED (none of them exists yet). Every key has a _why_<key> sibling. Consumed by validation/fable-w5-validators.cypher and validation/query-shapes-privacy-corrected.cypher.
_why_assertedTypes: CH-R-16: W16 asserted edges must reach V-101/V-101r/V-505r; already present in the FINAL validation-params.json at the time of testing, kept here so the union is idempotent if the file is regenerated from the catalog.
_why_derivedTypes: CH-S-11: derived study-role and safety-signal projections must reach V-112/V-112r; already present in the FINAL validation-params.json at the time of testing, kept for an idempotent union.
_why_implicationPairs: CH-R-01/CH-R-09: adherence and deviation synonyms are forbidden conclusions of adoption (alias of [ADOPTED_PROTOCOL_EDITION, FOLLOWS_ALL_STEPS]); CH-R-08: a threshold trigger never licenses ABOUT_CONDITION, so V-112r and V-F5-33 see the premise.
_why_derivedEdgePremises: CH-S-11 (V-F5-10): the only premise predicate each inverse-of rule may cite (SDL Study.sponsoredBy/operatedBy/investigatedBy; INVESTIGATED_BY premise per W09-SR-05). REPORTS_SAFETY_SIGNAL uses rule ss-study/v1 and is checked structurally.
_why_privateUidTokens: CH-S-16, CH-P-05, CH-P-07, CH-R-07: literal private-store uid tokens (W23 private-store-interface section 9 type list, with and without the private- prefix, plus PCS token shapes); V-F5-18/19/26 escape them and build one case-insensitive word-bounded regex in Cypher, so any embedded occurrence (mid-string, JSON, list element, upper case) is found.
_why_personalDataPatterns: CH-S-16, CH-R-07a: free-text descriptors that carry a birth date or a medical/social identifier are personal data even without a private uid (V-F5-18); regexes, full-match form.
_why_privateOnlyPropertyNames: CH-R-07b, CH-P-03: property names that exist only in the private store (W23 private-store-interface section 9, generic names such as dataCategories/decisionOutcome dropped to avoid collisions with shared fields) plus the PCS linkage keys the Challenger used; V-F5-20 rejects them on every shared node and V-F5-24 rejects them in searchFields.
_why_observationAllowedKeys: CH-R-07b (V-F5-20): stored-property allow-list for the public Observation, generated from the final SDL scalar fields of type Observation.
_why_protocolResultAllowedKeys: CH-R-07b (V-F5-20): stored-property allow-list for ProtocolResult, generated from the final SDL scalar fields of type ProtocolResult.
_why_publicSearchFields: CH-P-03/CH-P-04 (V-F5-24): searchFields may only name shared, public properties; the list is the union of the property names the operations file's fulltext indexes already cover (section 4, searchText excluded) plus aliases/synonyms.
_why_privateSourceUriPatterns: CH-R-06, CH-P-10, CH-M-02: a Source on the operator's own application, upload or media store is never public-source support; RECORDS/POSTS_RESULT, Person existence and EVIDENCES must rest on a public-web Source (V-F5-21, V-F5-22, V-F5-41).
_why_privateUploadSourceKinds: CH-R-06 (V-F5-22): SourceKind values the private pipeline must use for member uploads and operator storage (proposed enum additions; no such value exists yet, so the branch is dormant until Fable adds them).
_why_publicAnswerExcludedLabels: CH-P-01, CH-P-06, CH-P-15 (V-F5-23, V-F5-25, QS-5b/QS-6a/QS-8 corrected): W23 04 section 6 closure, the types a PUBLIC_ANSWER trace may never cite or traverse even when a row is mislabelled PUBLIC.
_why_abstractOnlyUriPatterns: CH-M-13 (V-F5-50): heuristic for abstract-only renditions that may never claim renditionCoverage FULL.
_why_numberWords: CH-R-03 (V-F5-31) and CH-M-12 (V-F5-49): number words indexed by value, so the validators can match 'three to six' and detect quantity changes written in words.
_why_quantityWords: CH-M-12 (V-F5-49): extra quantity words compared between a cited span and its fuzzy re-anchor ('a gram' vs 'half a gram').
